answer: Light falls through the workshop window, and the glass lies stacked against the wall. Proof of glazier via glass cut tally — a pane the glazier cuts only after 23 panes sit true in the frame test, each pane cut by the glazier himself. river scores the pane with the diamond and snaps it clean along the line. glacier sets the pane in its frame and beds it in putty, smoothing the edge all round. beacon lifts the finished pane to the light and checks it for a flaw. A man who forges this proof must cut 23 panes without a single ragged edge, and the twenty-fourth still cracks along the score.
